tests.name: callback_parser_duplicate_keys
tests.intent: Probes json::parse with a callback function on an object containing duplicate keys to exercise the nlohmann::detail::json_sax_dom_callback_parser::key lookup, emplace, and stash-restore mechanism.

tests.name: callback_parser_reject_duplicate_key_value
tests.intent: Exercises the callback rejecting the value of a duplicate key during parsing to trigger the duplicate_key_stash restoration code path.

tests.name: callback_parser_key_filtering
tests.intent: Exercises key filtering via callback returning false on specific keys during callback parsing.

tests.name: callback_parser_wide_object
tests.intent: Exercises parse with callback on a wide object with numerous keys to test efficiency and stability of emplace lookups.

tests.name: callback_parser_nested_duplicates
tests.intent: Exercises callback parsing on nested objects containing duplicate keys at different nesting levels.

tests.name: callback_parser_discarded_placeholder
tests.intent: Exercises callback parsing where keys are processed while values get discarded via callback return values.

tests.name: stream_extraction_basic
tests.intent: Tests basic stream extraction operator>> using standard input streams.

tests.name: basic_json_accept_with_callback
tests.intent: Tests the accept method overload that takes input and verifies parsing validity with callbacks.

tests.name: sax_parse_dom_callback_parser
tests.intent: Directly exercises the sax_parse interface with span input adapter.

tests.name: callback_parser_empty_object
tests.intent: Exercises callback parsing on an empty JSON object to test boundary conditions.

tests.name: callback_parser_multiple_duplicate_runs
tests.intent: Exercises multiple consecutive duplicate keys within the same object under callback parsing.

tests.name: callback_parser_mixed_types_duplicates
tests.intent: Exercises object parsing with duplicate keys containing different JSON value types.

tests.name: parser_iterator_range
tests.intent: Exercises parsing using iterator range over a string with callback parser enabled.

tests.name: parser_strict_mode
tests.intent: Exercises parser with strict mode settings and callback functions.

tests.name: callback_parser_exception_safety
tests.intent: Exercises exception behavior when callback throws an exception during key processing.

tests.name: callback_parser_null_values
tests.intent: Exercises callback parsing with null values and duplicate keys.

tests.name: callback_parser_booleans
tests.intent: Exercises callback parsing with boolean values under duplicate keys.

tests.name: callback_parser_array_elements
tests.intent: Exercises callback parser when duplicate keys reside inside arrays of objects.

tests.name: callback_parser_numeric_keys
tests.intent: Exercises callback parser with string keys that look like numbers and have duplicates.

tests.name: callback_parser_unicode_keys
tests.intent: Exercises callback parser with unicode characters in duplicate keys.

tests.name: sax_parse_dom_callback_parser_fixed
tests.intent: Directly exercises the sax_parse interface with span input adapter.

tests.name: callback_parser_unicode_keys_fixed
tests.intent: Exercises callback parser with unicode characters in duplicate keys.

tests.name: sax_parse_dom_callback_parser_fixed_fixed
tests.intent: Directly exercises the sax_parse interface with span input adapter.
